title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: ZovPersonal Consulting Services - Protection and Security of Your Personal Data

intro.title: Our Privacy Policy
intro.content: As ZovPersonal Consulting and Service Foreign Trade Inc., we show the highest level of sensitivity regarding the security of your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, process, protect and store your personal data when using our services.
intro.kvkk: As data controllers under the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), we ensure full compliance with legislation in the processing of your personal data.

processing.title: Purposes of Personal Data Processing
processing.description: We process your personal data for the following purposes:

security.title: Data Security
security.description: We take the following technical and administrative measures for the security of your personal data:
measures: Encrypted data transmission with SSL certificate

rights.title: Data Subject Rights
rights.description: You have the following rights under KVKK:

info.title: Right to Information
info.description: Right to learn whether your personal data is being processed

access.title: Right of Access
access.description: Right to request information about your processed personal data

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.description: Right to request correction of incorrect or incomplete data

erasure.title: Right to Erasure
erasure.description: Right to request deletion of your personal data

objection.title: Right to Object
objection.description: Right to object to data processing and request its cessation

portability.title: Right to Portability
portability.description: Right to request transfer of your data to another data controller

howToUse.title: How Can You Exercise Your Rights?
howToUse.description: You can use the following communication channels to exercise the above rights:
channels: Written application: Hand delivery or mail to our company address
Online form: Application form at www.zovpersonal.com

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: We use cookies on our website to improve user experience. Cookies are small text files stored in your web browser. You can control cookie usage from your browser settings.
